title: Open Question
description: Schema for a documented information gap (OQ-NNN) tracked by Agente01_ProductOwner

question.description: Precise, specific question — not vague. Must be answerable with a specific response.

context.description: Background context explaining why this question arose

impact.description: What cannot be decided, written, built, or validated without the answer to this question

criticality.description: BLOCKING=PRD cannot proceed; HIGH=next gate needs answer; MEDIUM=can resolve post-Gate1; LOW=nice to know

owner.description: Who is responsible for getting the answer — typically 'Tech Lead (routes to stakeholder)'

deadline.description: Sprint number or gate by which this must be resolved

status.description: Current status of the open question

resolution.description: The answer or decision that resolved this question — populated when status=RESOLVED

related_artifacts.description: PRD sections, user stories, or business rules that depend on this answer
